baseline.method: Independent author pyIrena IPG, full 500-point author demo, 500 radius bins, native discrepancy stopping

reference_role: Independently executed standard-method density; no actual generating distribution identified

metric_definitions.density_ncc: Standard flattened cosine similarity without centering
metric_definitions.density_nrmse: RMS density error divided by reference density dynamic range
metric_definitions.background_abs_error: Absolute nuisance background difference in cm^-1
metric_definitions.observation_reduced_chi_squared: Mean over all500 measured q of squared residual divided by supplied intensity uncertainty; no fitted rescaling

tolerance_rationale: Nonzero tolerances for method-reference reproducibility. Frozen original before extraction; local full pipeline gives same101updates and chi2 with floating point roundoff. Source criterionchi2/N<=1; small1.01margin is numerical and never overrides density/background agreement. Source200-bin poor fit rejected as discretization preflight; all500 observations retained with original uncertainties.
v2_definition: Nonnegative contrast-weighted density on the public grid, background equal to public high-q mean within the original1e-6cm^-1 budget, and all500 standardized observations chi2/500<=1.01. No hidden-density comparison or first-discrepancy-crossing iterate is required.
